tableSpecs.selectSql:
WITH "base_fact_revenue" AS (
  SELECT
    "fact"."DAY_ID" AS "DAY_ID",
    "fact"."SKU_ID" AS "SKU_ID",
    "fact"."REVENUE" AS "REVENUE"
  FROM "master"."FACT_REVENUE" AS "fact"
)
SELECT
  "dim_product"."CATEGORY_ID",
  "dim_date"."MONTH_ID",
  SUM("fact_revenue"."REVENUE") AS "REVENUE"
FROM "base_fact_revenue" AS "fact_revenue"
JOIN "CATEGORY_MONTHLY"."DIM_PRODUCT_SKU_ID" AS "dim_product" ON "fact_revenue"."SKU_ID" = "dim_product"."SKU_ID"
JOIN "CATEGORY_MONTHLY"."DIM_DATE_DAY_ID" AS "dim_date" ON "fact_revenue"."DAY_ID" = "dim_date"."DAY_ID"
GROUP BY
  "dim_product"."CATEGORY_ID",
  "dim_date"."MONTH_ID"

WITH "base_fact_orders" AS (
  SELECT
    "fact_orders"."DAY_ID" AS "DAY_ID",
    "fact_orders"."SKU_ID" AS "SKU_ID",
    SUM("fact_orders"."ORDERS") AS "ORDERS"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "fact_orders"."DAY_ID" AS "DAY_ID",
      "fact_orders"."SKU_ID" AS "SKU_ID",
      "fact_orders"."ORDERS" AS "ORDERS"
    FROM "master"."FACT_ORDERS" AS "fact_orders"
  ) AS "fact_orders"
  GROUP BY "fact_orders"."DAY_ID", "fact_orders"."SKU_ID"
),
"base_fact_revenue" AS (
  SELECT
    "fact_revenue"."DAY_ID" AS "DAY_ID",
    "fact_revenue"."SKU_ID" AS "SKU_ID",
    SUM("fact_revenue"."REVENUE") AS "REVENUE"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "fact_revenue"."DAY_ID" AS "DAY_ID",
      "fact_revenue"."SKU_ID" AS "SKU_ID",
      "fact_revenue"."REVENUE" AS "REVENUE"
    FROM "master"."FACT_REVENUE" AS "fact_revenue"
  ) AS "fact_revenue"
  GROUP BY "fact_revenue"."DAY_ID", "fact_revenue"."SKU_ID"
)
SELECT
  "dim_product"."CATEGORY_ID",
  "dim_date"."MONTH_ID",
  SUM("fact_revenue"."REVENUE") AS "REVENUE",
  SUM("fact_orders"."ORDERS") AS "ORDERS"
FROM "base_fact_orders" AS "fact_orders"
JOIN "base_fact_revenue" AS "fact_revenue" ON "fact_orders"."DAY_ID" = "fact_revenue"."DAY_ID" AND "fact_orders"."SKU_ID" = "fact_revenue"."SKU_ID"
JOIN "DAILY_SKU"."DIM_PRODUCT_SKU_ID" AS "dim_product" ON "fact_orders"."SKU_ID" = "dim_product"."SKU_ID"
JOIN "DAILY_SKU"."DIM_DATE_DAY_ID" AS "dim_date" ON "fact_orders"."DAY_ID" = "dim_date"."DAY_ID"
GROUP BY
  "dim_product"."CATEGORY_ID",
  "dim_date"."MONTH_ID"
